milestones.name: p1-m2-storage-layer
milestones.description: StoreBackend protocol, JsonStore implementation with atomic writes, directory/file creation, permission handling

milestones.name: p1-m3-add-command
milestones.description: URL validation, alias validation, deterministic 6-char base62 hash, add subcommand with CLI argument parsing

milestones.description: Resolve subcommand, lookup logic, error handling for unknown codes with exit 1

milestones.name: p1-m5-list-command
milestones.description: List subcommand with optional limit, tab-separated output format, sorting by creation time descending

milestones.name: p1-m6-rm-command
milestones.description: Remove subcommand, permanent deletion, error handling for unknown codes with exit 1

milestones.name: p1-m7-stats-command
milestones.description: Stats subcommand computing total count, 24-hour count, and most recent entry timestamp

milestones.name: p1-m8-cli-main
milestones.description: Main CLI entry point with subcommand routing, argument validation, deterministic behavior

milestones.name: p1-m9-quality-gates
milestones.description: Ruff zero-violations verification, 90% branch coverage, comprehensive test suite for all subcommands and error paths
